overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and approve minutes of its November 9, 2021 meeting, and declined to review the claim that the audio recording was altered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to timely approve minutes of its November 9, 2021 meeting; the Board had no minutes created or approved for that meeting.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and approve minutes of its November 9, 2021, meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board conspired to fraudulently alter an audio recording of the November 9 meeting to omit 20 minutes of the recording.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that public bodies record their own meetings, and therefore does not address whether a public body may edit a video recording of a meeting.

remedy: Within 30 days of the letter, create and approve minutes of the November 9, 2021 meeting.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; a future similar violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board, within 30 days from the date of this letter, to create and approve minutes of the November 9, 2021, meeting.
